decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (PL/VP/2191/MR/01, 02, 03, 04, 06 Received 24/05/2011, PL/VP/2191/MR/05AB, 07AB Received 01/08/2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The window formed in the northern side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in either flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and part first floor rear extension to the house.
